title: Seven programmable remote slots
purpose: Show the physical problem without reproducing the original photographed remote.
alt: 7개 장치 슬롯마다 ON·OFF 버튼이 있고 최근 명령을 취소하는 공통 UNDO 버튼을 둔 리모컨
requiredChecks: Exactly seven numbered slots are shown, each with one ON and one OFF button.
Slot labels are programmable device assignments; no fixed vendor dependency is implied.
One global UNDO button reverses the last executed command, not all seven slots.
prompt: Create a NEW ORIGINAL raster technical diagram for an IT study blog, opaque white background, clean navy sans-serif typography, restrained blue/teal/amber flat cards, spacious margins, exact monospaced class and method identifiers, no logos, source screenshots or copied slide composition. All English text clearly readable. Title 'Seven programmable remote slots'. Draw a clean original front-facing schematic remote with exactly SEVEN rows numbered 0–6, columns SLOT / DEVICE / ON / OFF. Each DEVICE field is blank dash or 'assign device'; 14 buttons total in aligned ON/OFF columns. Beneath all rows ONE separate UNDO button caption 'Undo the last command'. Side explanatory cards 'Assign a device to each slot' and 'Each slot has an ON and an OFF action'. Use a flat rectangular diagram, no photorealistic hardware, no copied handwriting, no branding.
